summary: Firefox’s RTCPeerConnection WebRTC implementation received a broad cleanup and reliability update: codec and RTP header-extension handling was simplified, H.264 telemetry was restored, and WebRTC statistics were moved into persistent history. RTCDataChannel objects are now kept alive correctly, and SCTP data-connection failures are surfaced as RTCError instead of being hidden. The changes also improve media negotiation and make peer-connection failures easier for applications to detect and diagnose.
